propositions: Rebar must support safe credential injection for Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gerrit, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, and Jira across multiple deployment environments without weakening upstream SDK-native refresh, workload identity, or rotation mechanisms
Current defect: _bridge_runner copies full parent environment to reconciler and ticket delivery, leaking unrelated provider credentials to lower-trust processes

Recommended design: deployment resolves static secrets before process startup; Rebar accepts provider-native auth capabilities (not universal string lookups) and narrows secret access to owning adapter boundaries only

Operation-certificate signing should accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH (preferred file) or multiline REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment value, with no application-owned SSM coupling or runtime boto3 dependency
Static credential rotation is restart/redeploy-based; no in-process hot-reload, watch, or refresh for externally managed static values; native workload credentials remain SDK-owned

Subprocess children inherit ambient environment for trusted same-capability use; Rebar overlays static values only onto owning child and removes exact sibling secret names, never mutating global os.environ
